g.title: X1
g.text: 3.3 V logic ONLY - not 5 V tolerant

g.title: W1
g.text: Colours suggested - record as-built. Keep short, away from motor leads

g.title: X2
g.text: UART: 4-pin header, order per design note §2.2 (silkscreen TO VERIFY); TX2 idle ≤ 3.3 V (TC-A-05)
M1/M2: 2-pin motor ports (type TO VERIFY), NOT the 6-pin encoder headers; M3/M4 unused

g.title: X8
g.text: LV alarm on the balance lead (JST-XH)

g.title: W4
g.text: Power feed (+ via F1 fuse, S1 switch)
1 x #10 (Inline blade fuse holder + ~10 A fuse (F1))
F1 ~10 A inline fuse and S1 main switch in the + wire, in that order
S1 output also feeds the 5 V buck for the BeagleY-AI (power diagram, TBD)
